{{Quote|And when you were with the Cheems family?''"<br />"''No&hellip; They kept me away from much of the war news. I simply studied. And I have seen your hatred of my kind before. My parents lost many friends when they adopted me.|Voort saBinring to Viull Gorsat|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Cheems family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family headed by mineral analyst [[Mulus Cheems]] and his [[Viull Gorsat's adopted mother|wife]]. They had a [[Mulus Cheems's son|son]] and at least two daughters.<ref name="MK" /> 

Sometime during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Cheems family adopted a young [[Viull Gorsat]] from the [[Shamed Ones|Shamed Ones]], the lowest [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|caste]] within the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] hierarchy. Gorsat later joined [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit that had once saved the life of his adopted father.<ref name="MK" />
